svg.title: TimeIt timer types (dark)
03-interlocking-lanes
svg.desc: TimeIt Interlocking Lanes, symbol-color. Standalone symbol without lettering.

g.aria-label: TWO WAYS TO BUILD YOUR ROUTINE
Set standby, work, rest and rounds.
Standby runs once at the beginning.
The final round ends after work.
Stack your own standby, work and rest phases.
Set a duration for each phase.
Repeat the whole sequence in cycles.
Edit the sequence to fit your workout.
Diagram summary, not an app screenshot. Your durations and repetitions are configurable.

svg.desc: Simple timers use one standby and repeated work/rest rounds, without rest after the last work round. Advanced timers repeat a custom sequence in cycles.
